analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 32.3 to 50.7, confirming exit from oversold territory. MACD histogram also improved from -1.6211 to 1.7470, strengthening the uptrend. The current price ($365.53) is forming a Higher Low relative to the 5-day low ($335.81), indicating the start of a recovery phase.
